notes: Hand-checked products available in Germany. 'inci' is copied from the cited source; 'partial' means the source didn't give the full list. Formulas change: always check the pack. test/match.test.js enforces zero red hits unless 'medicine' is true (a short-contact antifungal medicine whose benefit outweighs a minor ester).

products.name: Terzolin® 2% Lösung (ketoconazole)
products.where: Apotheke (no prescription), also dm online via pharmacy partner
products.inci: Ketoconazole 2%, Aqua, Sodium Laureth Sulfate, Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate, PEG-120 Methyl Glucose Dioleate, Sodium Chloride, Sodium Hydroxide, Hydrochloric Acid, Benzyl Alcohol, Benzoic Acid, BHT, Erythrosine
products.note: First-line treatment. Leave on 3–5 min, 2×/week for 2–4 weeks, then every 1–2 weeks. Also usable as a body wash for Malassezia folliculitis.

products.name: sebamed Anti-Schuppen Shampoo Plus
products.inci: Aqua, Sodium Laureth Sulfate, Lauryl Glucoside, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate, Sodium Chloride, Hydroxypropyl Oxidized Starch PG-Trimonium Chloride, Piroctone Olamine, Menthol, Parfum, Citric Acid, Phenoxyethanol, Sodium Benzoate, CI 42090, CI 47005
products.note: Piroctone olamine, no esters or oils. The plain 'Anti-Schuppen' (non-Plus) version contains glycol distearate.

products.name: Vichy Dercos Anti-Schuppen Shampoo (normale bis fettige Kopfhaut)
products.inci: Aqua, Sodium Laureth Sulfate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Selenium Disulfide, Salicylic Acid, PPG-5-Ceteth-20, Carbomer, Glycerin, Dimethicone, Menthol, Sodium Benzoate, Citric Acid, Tocopheryl Acetate, 2-Oleamido-1,3-Octadecanediol, Parfum
products.note: Selenium disulfide + salicylic acid. Contains a ceramide and a ceteth (amber). Good rotation partner for ketoconazole.

products.name: Pure MCT oil (C8/C10), e.g. Sunday Natural or Aurica Bio MCT-Öl
products.where: Online, Reformhaus, some drugstores (food-grade is fine)
products.note: Malassezia-safe oil for dry lengths, beard or skin. Check it says 100% C8/C10; some 'MCT' oils contain longer chains.

products.name: The Ordinary 100% Plant-Derived Squalane
products.note: Malassezia-safe emollient for barrier repair (face, hairline, ends).

products.name: Pure petrolatum (Vaseline, any brand)
products.note: Occlusive barrier repair for very dry, cracked patches. Not on hairy/follicle-prone areas (can occlude follicles).
